The proposed framework is designed to make business registration and operation within the EU faster, easier and more harmonized.

title: El Niño and tropical Atlantic warming could offer early warning of extreme heat in the Amazon
summary: El Niño and warming in the tropical Atlantic could help provide advance warning of extreme heat in the Amazon, with some signals appearing as much as seven months earlier, new research has found. Researchers from the ARC Center of Excellence for the Weather of the 21st Century and the National Institute of Space Research in Brazil studied how major patterns of natural climate variability influence temperature and rainfall extremes across the Amazon Basin.

title: A 2-in-1 approach captures toxic metals and recovers rare earth elements from wastewater
summary: We generally throw away a broken camera lens, earphones or an old phone that has stopped working and is beyond repair because they seem useless when they no longer function. However, these objects contain rare earth elements (REEs) that have applications in magnets, superconductivity, optics and batteries, among others. When these objects end up in water, recovering REEs becomes difficult.
